claims.hypothesis: Is the DLA galaxy gas-rich but with unusually low SFR relative to flux-selected samples?
claims.experiment: Compare SFR vs molecular gas fraction in a stellar-mass slice with COLD GASS, PHIBSS, CANDELS
claims.result: g1323 falls well below the relation for both Halpha and total SFR
claims.finding: g1323 has no counterparts in flux-selected samples in SFR-gas fraction space

evidence.quote: g1323 lies well below this relation.

claims.hypothesis: Does the CO line width follow the CO Tully-Fisher relation?
claims.experiment: Double-horn fit W50/W20, compare with COLD GASS TF
claims.result: W50 = 647 km/s, significantly right of relation
claims.finding: Wide CO may be partly from a separate kinematic component

evidence.quote: g1323 is seen to fall significantly right of the relation.
